notes: Focused public C++ CreateFederationExecution evidence for IEEE 1516.2-2025 §6.2.14 p. 94 l. 34 and l. 38. The reserved-HLA-prefix basicData name is valid under the pinned DIF XSD's IdentifierType/NCName but is rejected by Create, providing a bounded HLA naming-convention witness. Normal non-reserved names with Endian=Big and Endian=Little are accepted by Create and joined; Endian=Middle is rejected by the pinned DIF XSD enumeration. The Middle case is schema-level field-value evidence, not semantic post-XSD validation. The corpus also performs valid same-federation-name recovery. These selected fields do not establish validation of every basicData row, every naming boundary, every XSD construct, or IEEE conformance.

requirement_mappings.note: The public Create service rejects one XSD-valid basicData IdentifierType name beginning with the reserved HLA prefix. This tests the selected Name rule only, not all clause 3.3 naming constraints.

The public Create service accepts XSD-valid basicData fixtures with Endian=Big and Endian=Little and rejects Endian=Middle at the pinned XSD enumeration boundary. These are bounded witnesses for the two permitted values and one invalid value only.
